body.name: ExtrinsicSuccess
docs: An extrinsic completed successfully.

body.name: ExtrinsicFailed
docs: An extrinsic failed.

body.name: CodeUpdated
docs: `:code` was updated.

body.name: NewAccount
docs: A new account was created.

body.name: KilledAccount
docs: An account was reaped.

body.name: Remarked
docs: On on-chain remark happened.

body.name: UpgradeAuthorized
docs: An upgrade was authorized.

body.name: RejectedInvalidAuthorizedUpgrade
docs: An invalid authorized upgrade was rejected while trying to apply it.

body.name: Endowed
docs: An account was created with some free balance.

body.name: DustLost
docs: An account was removed whose balance was non-zero but below ExistentialDeposit,
resulting in an outright loss.

body.name: Transfer
docs: Transfer succeeded.

body.name: BalanceSet
docs: A balance was set by root.

body.name: Reserved
docs: Some balance was reserved (moved from free to reserved).

body.name: Unreserved
docs: Some balance was unreserved (moved from reserved to free).

body.name: ReserveRepatriated
docs: Some balance was moved from the reserve of the first account to the second account.
Final argument indicates the destination balance type.

body.name: Deposit
docs: Some amount was deposited (e.g. for transaction fees).

body.name: Withdraw
docs: Some amount was withdrawn from the account (e.g. for transaction fees).

body.name: Slashed
docs: Some amount was removed from the account (e.g. for misbehavior).

body.name: Minted
docs: Some amount was minted into an account.

body.name: Burned
docs: Some amount was burned from an account.

body.name: Suspended
docs: Some amount was suspended from an account (it can be restored later).

body.name: Restored
docs: Some amount was restored into an account.

body.name: Upgraded
docs: An account was upgraded.

body.name: Issued
docs: Total issuance was increased by `amount`, creating a credit to be balanced.

body.name: Rescinded
docs: Total issuance was decreased by `amount`, creating a debt to be balanced.

body.name: Locked
docs: Some balance was locked.

body.name: Unlocked
docs: Some balance was unlocked.

body.name: Frozen
docs: Some balance was frozen.

body.name: Thawed
docs: Some balance was thawed.

body.name: TotalIssuanceForced
docs: The `TotalIssuance` was forcefully changed.

body.name: TransactionFeePaid
docs: A transaction fee `actual_fee`, of which `tip` was added to the minimum inclusion fee,
has been paid by `who`.

body.name: Sudid

fields.name: sudo_result
docs: The result of the call made by the sudo user.
A sudo call just took place.

body.name: KeyChanged

fields.name: old
docs: The old sudo key (if one was previously set).

fields.name: new
docs: The new sudo key (if one was set).
The sudo key has been updated.

body.name: KeyRemoved
docs: The key was permanently removed.

body.name: SudoAsDone

fields.name: sudo_result
docs: The result of the call made by the sudo user.
A [sudo_as](Pallet::sudo_as) call just took place.

body.name: EraPaid
docs: The era payout has been set; the first balance is the validator-payout; the second is
the remainder from the maximum amount of reward.

body.name: Rewarded
docs: The nominator has been rewarded by this amount to this destination.

body.name: Slashed
docs: A staker (validator or nominator) has been slashed by the given amount.

body.name: SlashReported
docs: A slash for the given validator, for the given percentage of their stake, at the given
era as been reported.

body.name: OldSlashingReportDiscarded
docs: An old slashing report from a prior era was discarded because it could
not be processed.

body.name: StakersElected
docs: A new set of stakers was elected.

body.name: Bonded
docs: An account has bonded this amount. \[stash, amount\]
NOTE: This event is only emitted when funds are bonded via a dispatchable. Notably,
it will not be emitted for staking rewards when they are added to stake.

body.name: Unbonded
docs: An account has unbonded this amount.

body.name: Withdrawn
docs: An account has called `withdraw_unbonded` and removed unbonding chunks worth `Balance`
from the unlocking queue.

body.name: Kicked
docs: A nominator has been kicked from a validator.

body.name: StakingElectionFailed
docs: The election failed. No new era is planned.

body.name: Chilled
docs: An account has stopped participating as either a validator or nominator.

body.name: PayoutStarted
docs: A Page of stakers rewards are getting paid. `next` is `None` if all pages are claimed.

body.name: ValidatorPrefsSet
docs: A validator has set their preferences.

body.name: SnapshotVotersSizeExceeded
docs: Voters size limit reached.

body.name: SnapshotTargetsSizeExceeded
docs: Targets size limit reached.

body.name: ForceEra
docs: A new force era mode was set.

body.name: ControllerBatchDeprecated
docs: Report of a controller batch deprecation.

body.name: CurrencyMigrated
docs: Staking balance migrated from locks to holds, with any balance that could not be held
is force withdrawn.

body.name: NewSession
docs: New session has happened. Note that the argument is the session index, not the
block number as the type might suggest.

body.name: NewQueued
docs: The `NewSession` event in the current block also implies a new validator set to be
queued.

body.name: ValidatorDisabled
docs: Validator has been disabled.

body.name: ValidatorReenabled
docs: Validator has been re-enabled.

body.name: RootStored
docs: The merkle root of the validators of the said session were stored

body.name: RootsPruned
docs: The merkle roots of up to this session index were pruned

body.name: NewAuthorities
docs: New authority set has been applied.

body.name: Paused
docs: Current authority set has been paused.

body.name: Resumed
docs: Current authority set has been resumed.

body.name: VestingCreated
docs: A vesting schedule has been created.

body.name: VestingUpdated
docs: The amount vested has been updated. This could indicate a change in funds available.
The balance given is the amount which is left unvested (and thus locked).

body.name: VestingCompleted
docs: An \[account\] has become fully vested.

body.name: NewMultisig
docs: A new multisig operation has begun.

body.name: MultisigApproval
docs: A multisig operation has been approved by someone.

body.name: MultisigExecuted
docs: A multisig operation has been executed.

body.name: MultisigCancelled
docs: A multisig operation has been cancelled.

body.name: DepositPoked
docs: The deposit for a multisig operation has been updated/poked.

body.name: ProxyExecuted
docs: A proxy was executed correctly, with the given.

body.name: PureCreated
docs: A pure account has been created by new proxy with given
disambiguation index and proxy type.

body.name: PureKilled
docs: A pure proxy was killed by its spawner.

body.name: Announced
docs: An announcement was placed to make a call in the future.

body.name: ProxyAdded
docs: A proxy was added.

body.name: ProxyRemoved
docs: A proxy was removed.

body.name: DepositPoked
docs: A deposit stored for proxies or announcements was poked / updated.

body.name: Created
docs: Some asset class was created.

body.name: Issued
docs: Some assets were issued.

body.name: Transferred
docs: Some assets were transferred.

body.name: Burned
docs: Some assets were destroyed.

body.name: TeamChanged
docs: The management team changed.

body.name: OwnerChanged
docs: The owner changed.

body.name: Frozen
docs: Some account `who` was frozen.

body.name: Thawed
docs: Some account `who` was thawed.

body.name: AssetFrozen
docs: Some asset `asset_id` was frozen.

body.name: AssetThawed
docs: Some asset `asset_id` was thawed.

body.name: AccountsDestroyed
docs: Accounts were destroyed for given asset.

body.name: ApprovalsDestroyed
docs: Approvals were destroyed for given asset.

body.name: DestructionStarted
docs: An asset class is in the process of being destroyed.

body.name: Destroyed
docs: An asset class was destroyed.

body.name: ForceCreated
docs: Some asset class was force-created.

body.name: MetadataSet
docs: New metadata has been set for an asset.

body.name: MetadataCleared
docs: Metadata has been cleared for an asset.

body.name: ApprovedTransfer
docs: (Additional) funds have been approved for transfer to a destination account.

body.name: ApprovalCancelled
docs: An approval for account `delegate` was cancelled by `owner`.

body.name: TransferredApproved
docs: An `amount` was transferred in its entirety from `owner` to `destination` by
the approved `delegate`.

body.name: AssetStatusChanged
docs: An asset has had its attributes changed by the `Force` origin.

body.name: AssetMinBalanceChanged
docs: The min_balance of an asset has been updated by the asset owner.

body.name: Touched
docs: Some account `who` was created with a deposit from `depositor`.

body.name: Blocked
docs: Some account `who` was blocked.

body.name: Deposited
docs: Some assets were deposited (e.g. for transaction fees).

body.name: Withdrawn
docs: Some assets were withdrawn from the account (e.g. for transaction fees).

body.name: Created
docs: A `collection` was created.

body.name: ForceCreated
docs: A `collection` was force-created.

body.name: Destroyed
docs: A `collection` was destroyed.

body.name: Issued
docs: An `item` was issued.

body.name: Transferred
docs: An `item` was transferred.

body.name: Burned
docs: An `item` was destroyed.

body.name: ItemTransferLocked
docs: An `item` became non-transferable.

body.name: ItemTransferUnlocked
docs: An `item` became transferable.

body.name: ItemPropertiesLocked
docs: `item` metadata or attributes were locked.

body.name: CollectionLocked
docs: Some `collection` was locked.

body.name: OwnerChanged
docs: The owner changed.

body.name: TeamChanged
docs: The management team changed.

body.name: TransferApproved
docs: An `item` of a `collection` has been approved by the `owner` for transfer by
a `delegate`.

body.name: ApprovalCancelled
docs: An approval for a `delegate` account to transfer the `item` of an item
`collection` was cancelled by its `owner`.

body.name: AllApprovalsCancelled
docs: All approvals of an item got cancelled.

body.name: CollectionConfigChanged
docs: A `collection` has had its config changed by the `Force` origin.

body.name: CollectionMetadataSet
docs: New metadata has been set for a `collection`.

body.name: CollectionMetadataCleared
docs: Metadata has been cleared for a `collection`.

body.name: ItemMetadataSet
docs: New metadata has been set for an item.

body.name: ItemMetadataCleared
docs: Metadata has been cleared for an item.

body.name: Redeposited
docs: The deposit for a set of `item`s within a `collection` has been updated.

body.name: AttributeSet
docs: New attribute metadata has been set for a `collection` or `item`.

body.name: AttributeCleared
docs: Attribute metadata has been cleared for a `collection` or `item`.

body.name: ItemAttributesApprovalAdded
docs: A new approval to modify item attributes was added.

body.name: ItemAttributesApprovalRemoved
docs: A new approval to modify item attributes was removed.

body.name: OwnershipAcceptanceChanged
docs: Ownership acceptance has changed for an account.

body.name: CollectionMaxSupplySet
docs: Max supply has been set for a collection.

body.name: CollectionMintSettingsUpdated
docs: Mint settings for a collection had changed.

body.name: NextCollectionIdIncremented
docs: Event gets emitted when the `NextCollectionId` gets incremented.

body.name: ItemPriceSet
docs: The price was set for the item.

body.name: ItemPriceRemoved
docs: The price for the item was removed.

body.name: ItemBought
docs: An item was bought.

body.name: TipSent
docs: A tip was sent.

body.name: SwapCreated
docs: An `item` swap intent was created.

body.name: SwapCancelled
docs: The swap was cancelled.

body.name: SwapClaimed
docs: The swap has been claimed.

body.name: PreSignedAttributesSet
docs: New attributes have been set for an `item` of the `collection`.

body.name: PalletAttributeSet
docs: A new attribute in the `Pallet` namespace was set for the `collection` or an `item`
within that `collection`.

body.name: CollectionRetirementStarted
docs: The collection owner has begun irreversible retirement.

body.name: CollectionRetirementProgress
docs: A bounded retirement batch completed.

body.name: AttributeCountReconciled
docs: Historical non-monetary attribute overcount reconciled after proven emptiness.

body.name: DelegateCleanupProgress
docs: A delegated cleanup batch completed; no marker remains when complete.

body.name: Issued
docs: New ETKN was created through the single controlled interface.

body.name: GrossIssued
docs: One complete V14 gross issuance was atomically split between protocol accounts.
